summary: Phase 3-5 backend tests: Aircraft Catalog & Verification System, Transparent Price Breakup, Operator Settlement, and 15-min Price Lock Timer. 25/25 tests passed. All calculation formulas (10% commission + ₹500 fixed fee, 18% GST on subtotal+platform fee, 2% TDS on operator settlement) validated with exact numeric assertions. Full CRUD lifecycle with GET-verify-persistence pattern tested for aircraft catalog. Price lock timer, validation, use, reuse-fails, and cross-user access denial all verified.
critical_code_review_comments: No DELETE endpoint for aircraft; operators cannot remove listings. Consider adding soft-delete.

price_breakup_routes.calculate_customer_breakup: taxable_amount includes discounted_subtotal + platform_fee, but platform_fee itself is derived from base_price only. If subtotal drops below platform_fee via large discount, taxable may become negative-ish; add discount validation (discount <= subtotal).
aircraft_catalog_routes.calculate_expiry_status uses datetime.now().date() (naive local time) while creation uses UTC — could lead to off-by-one on day boundary. Prefer timezone-aware UTC dates.

aircraft update endpoint sets dotted-path fields (verification.status) alongside top-level dict fields in the same $set — works but risks conflict if both top-level 'verification' and 'verification.status' set together elsewhere.
POST /pricing/lock/{id}/use accepts payment_id as function arg (query param). FastAPI treats it as query param — acceptable but body would be more RESTful.
get_public_aircraft/search do not filter out crew PII robustly (crew is embedded array; projection {'crew.licence_number': 0} works, but future-added PII fields would leak).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 aircraft (registration VT-TEST<ts>) via operator8fkf0x@airyatra.com and 1 price_lock via loyaltytest@airyatra.com; both cleaned up in cleanup tests.
test_credentials: JWT tokens generated directly via /app/backend/auth.create_access_token for operator8fkf0x, admin@airyatra.com, loyaltytest@airyatra.com (bypasses OTP).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Aircraft catalog & pricing endpoints are stable. Frontend components (AircraftCatalog.js, PriceBreakup.js) not yet tested; blocked by OTP login. Numeric formulas validated: 10%+₹500 platform fee, 18% GST on (subtotal+platform_fee), 2% TDS. Price lock enforces 5-30 min duration via Pydantic (422 outside range).
